text:
For this activity, you will need a mirror and some coins.

Larry the Leprechaun can show you more money than you think you’ve got. Put a 10p coin next to your mirror. Can you see 20p in total?!

What coins do you think you need to give Larry the Leprechaun so that you can see a total of 40p? 48p? 30p?

Challenge yourself to make different amounts!
